source_en: Papers. Here. Guram Kopaliani. Parking lot on Rustaveli, twenty-two years.
New face. The last officer was faster. Doesn't matter.
Three months. Since the first barrier went up.
Two Volgas and a Party car. The rest stopped coming. I still log them.
I'll keep coming until there's no lot to come back to.
Nobody. Wife died four years ago. House is quieter than the lot.
Everything closes. I'll find something else to stand in front of.
Stamp it. I mind standing still.
